_doc: Newblades enchant tuning (tracker #415). NOT retail data: enchanting.json holds the APK's tables, this file overrides them. Every key defaults to today's behaviour when absent, and a missing or invalid file is the default. Read at startup: edit, then `deploy/arena.sh static` (restarts the arena).
_secondaryCountOdds: Owner decision d22. P(0), P(1), P(2) secondary enchantments for a NON-arcane item, per item type; first matching rule wins, and a table no rule matches keeps its retail odds. itemType: 2 weapon, 3 armor, 9 shield, 10 ring, 11 necklace. equipmentSlot (armor): 1 head, 3 body, 4 hands, 7 feet. weaponType: absent = every weapon. Every row is HauDrauf's rule, shipped under the owner's standing rule for his common-good changes: weapons and rings 25/50/25 (tracker #415, 2026-10-25); shields like weapons 25/50/25, and rings, necklaces and every armour slot 25/40/35 (tracker #493, 2026-11-11, 'no best combination there'). The retail numbers (SecondaryEnchantmentEffectData in the APK) are in each label. Revert #493: put shields, necklaces and armour back to their retail numbers and rings back to 25/50/25. Arcane tiers are not affected (arcaneTierCountOdds / the APK's fixed counts).
_doubleRavagePity: Owner decision d17, not retail. After `tries[class]` weapon enchants in a row without both Ravage Magicka and Ravage Stamina, the next one in that class gets both. class: normal = no arcane tier, arcane2 = arcane tier 2 (arcane 1 rolls one secondary, so it has no timer). Thresholds = expected tries 1 / (P(two secondaries) x 2 x 0.07 x 0.07 / 0.93): 632.7 normal at retail weapon P(2)=0.15, 379.6 at the current 0.25; 94.9 arcane2 (fixed two). Recompute normal whenever the weapon P(2) changes. arcane2 = 49 and shield:arcane2 = 49 are HauDrauf's rule (tracker #463, 2026-11-04): weapons and shields with two guaranteed enchantments get the pair on the 50th enchant in a row without it, counter restarting on success (was arcane2 95, shields not counted). Shields count under 'shield:<class>' with the shield Ravage pair (natural chance 2 x 0.16 x 0.16 / 0.84 = 6.1% at arcane2, so the timer rarely fires). Revert: arcane2 back to 95, delete shield:arcane2. shield:normal = 66 is HauDrauf's rule (tracker #493, 2026-11-11, 'all shields exactly like the weapons'): a plain shield gets the shield pair after its expected tries, 1 / (0.25 x 2 x 0.16 x 0.16 / 0.84) = 65.6 at the shield P(2) 0.25, the same rule that gives weapons 380. Recompute it whenever the shield P(2) changes; revert #493: delete shield:normal. A class absent or set to 0 is never forced. enabled: false turns the timer off.
_arcaneTierCountOdds: HauDrauf's rule (tracker #485, 2026-11-09, under the owner's standing rule for his common-good changes), not retail. P(0), P(1), P(2) secondaries per arcane tier, replacing the APK's fixed counts for the tiers named here. Arcane I (the shop's 'one guaranteed enchantment') keeps its guaranteed one and rolls a second with the chance a plain weapon has of two, 0.25 (secondaryCountOdds weapons). Retail / revert: delete this key (APK: tier 1 = [0, 1, 0]).
